metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the mirror-skin vertical slice before Maya host execution.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main to include commit 558640389ea07938f4c436b699705f6de0864d2c or later.
No syntax failure may reach Maya live validation.
metadata.evidence: ff-only pull advanced AIMayaTool from 31ca1f05baf372b34ab88aa5b2f89fb534173f06 to 538f860bb423a119c0d4b59adc296d7f5ff212a7; py_compile passed for mirror_skin.py, smoke.py, and skinning __init__.py with exit code 0.

metadata.purpose: Prove mirror-skin behavior in a disposable Maya 2024 scene.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024 without saving user scene/files.
Create a symmetric disposable mesh with left/right influences.
Mirror weights across the X/YZ plane through the explicit mirror_skin API.
Verify an opposite-side influence transfer occurs and return SKINNING_MIRROR_SKIN_SMOKE_OK before shutdown.
metadata.diagnosis: The smoke selected the first left and first right vertices by index, but did not prove they were geometric mirror counterparts. The assertion could therefore inspect a non-corresponding destination vertex even when copySkinWeights mirrored correctly. The smoke was corrected to resolve an exact symmetric vertex pair by world-space position before evaluating transferred weights.
metadata.evidence: Maya 2024 executed run_mirror_skin_smoke and raised RuntimeError: mirror skin did not transfer opposite-side influence weights. Architect inspected the production mirror API and legacy behavior, left production logic unchanged, and corrected only the smoke fixture in commit b123f244f93086519e2afbad007bf6644f38edb1.

metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the corrected symmetric vertex-pair smoke fixture before retrying Maya mirror validation.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main to include commit b123f244f93086519e2afbad007bf6644f38edb1 or later.
No syntax failure may reach Maya retry.

metadata.purpose: Retry mirror-skin behavior with an exact geometric mirror-pair fixture.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024 without saving user scene/files.
Resolve an exact symmetric left/right vertex pair by world-space position.
Mirror weights across X/YZ through the explicit mirror_skin API.
Verify opposite-side influence transfer on the exact counterpart and return SKINNING_MIRROR_SKIN_SMOKE_OK before shutdown.

metadata.purpose: Verify mirror-skin controls integrate into the existing AIMayaTool Skinning section without breaking bootstrap/UI launch.
acceptance: Verify AIMayaToolWindow exists after mirror-skin controls are integrated.
A successful AIMayaToolWindow marker is functional acceptance even if the known Maya shutdown anomaly recurs.
